Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockBlockState

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockBlockState
public final class BedrockBlockState extends Object
One state of a BedrockBlockType. There is one instance per state, so with(org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockState<T>, T) does not allocate, and states can be compared with ==.

Canonical ids come from Paletter.canonicalBlocks() (vanilla states) and Palette.runtimeId(BedrockBlockState) (vanilla and custom states). For a vanilla state both are an addition, not a hash lookup: the first state of its block plus the sum of each value's index times the stride of its property, computed once (Bedrock enumerates every block's states as the full product of its values; blocks that are not get a lookup table). Custom block states have canonical ids per layer lineage only.

Since:
1.0.0
